title: Coveo - Total cost of ownership rises with platform growth
clean_text: Users report that as Coveo's platform usage and feature adoption grows within an organization, total cost of ownership increases substantially over time. The platform is positioned as a broad enterprise relevance solution spanning ecommerce, customer service, and internal workplace search rather than a dedicated ecommerce recommendation tool, which means ecommerce-only buyers pay for capabilities outside their core need. Smaller businesses seeking a lower-cost, ecommerce-focused alternative frequently look to more specialized competitors instead.
